From: Alex Grant <alex.grant@tidewater.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted -> Dedicated migration plan + sizing validation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Tidewater is ready to move from the Hosted API to a dedicated pool for Production. We need a firm plan for sizing validation and a short cutover window that minimizes risk to our customers. Context below: 

- Current monthly token volume: ~1.2B tokens (text generation + embeddings)
- Peak concurrent requests: ~140 rps (short bursty spikes during model training night jobs)
- SLA target: p95 generation latency < 350ms, 99.9% availability during business hours (PST)
- Target go-live: week of Oct 9 (we can be flexible by ±1 week)

Can you send a proposed validation tempo (staged tests, stress windows), initial GPU capacity estimate, and recommended rollback/fallback windows? I attached our traffic sample and SLA doc.

Also want to confirm the procurement steps — our procurement team will need an SOW and an invoice/PO to proceed.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Alex Grant
Head of Platform | Tidewater Inc.
Attachments: tidewater_traffic_profile.csv, SLA_requirements.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@tidewater.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-22T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated migration plan + sizing validation

Hi Alex — thanks for the detail and the samples, very helpful. High level proposal below; attaching an initial sizing workbook so your infra and procurement teams can see the assumptions.

Proposed validation tempo (2.5 weeks):
- Week 1 (Preflight): sizing sync, confirm traffic shapes, reserve dedicated pool (staging), baseline smoke tests (no production traffic)
- Week 2 (Staged load & canary): mirrored traffic in staging, canary window with 5% of production traffic for 48 hours, throughput ramps and latency checks against p95 target
- Week 2.5 (Swap weekend): short blackout window (2 hours) for DNS flip + final mirroring; rollback window: next 4 hours if indicators deviate

Initial sizing assumptions (see workbook):
- Model: mix of Llama-3-70B and 13B embeddings variants (quantized ops)
- Target sustained throughput: 80 qps, burst headroom to 200 rps for short intervals
- Estimated baseline fleet: 12 x A100-80GB equiv (auto-shard policy), 3x staging GPUs for canary; adjust after staging perf run

Safety & fallback:
- Prefix caching enabled to reduce token cost during mirrored tests
- Automatic fallback to hosted model variants for ~90s per-request if KV cache warms fail
- Canary abort triggers: p95 > 400ms for > 10m, error rate spike > 0.8%

Next steps for us:
1) Review the sizing workbook and confirm model mix and tokenization assumptions (I included a conservative and an aggressive column).
2) Schedule a 45m runbook walk-through with our SREs and your infra team — propose Sep 26 10:00am PT.
3) Procurement: we can share a draft SOW after the walk-through; if agreed we’ll forward the DocuSign link.

Attaching: redwood-dedicated-sizing-proposal.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sizing-proposal.xlsx
